title: Bash Platform & Memory
description: Platform compatibility headers that have no schema-worthy types but are documented for completeness. Covers bashansi.h, bashtypes.h, bashintl.h, config-bot.h, conftypes.h, dispose_cmd.h, sig.h, siglist.h, unwind_prot.h, xmalloc.h, bashline.h, patchlevel.h.

CoveredHeaders.description: Headers with no meaningful data types for a JS parser. Listed for audit completeness.

bashansi.h.description: ANSI C compat: string.h, stdlib.h, stdbool.h, stddef.h includes

bashtypes.h.description: System types: sys/types.h, inttypes.h, stdint.h includes

bashintl.h.description: i18n: gettext macros _(), N_(), D_(), P_()

config-bot.h.description: Post-configure adjustments: feature guards, multibyte detection

dispose_cmd.h.description: AST node destructor API (C memory management, N/A for JS)

sig.h.description: Signal handler types and macros (BLOCK_SIGNAL, etc.)

unwind_prot.h.description: Unwind protection (C longjmp cleanup, N/A for JS)

bashline.h.description: Readline integration API (interactive shell, not parsing)

PatchLevel.description: Current bash patch level from patchlevel.h
